[{"insert":"Pronated Pull Up + Supinated Pull Up

Back to the pronated pull up drop set with reps dropping to 6, paired again with the supinated pull up at the same load. The supinated grip recruits more biceps to assist the lat, which means you can push more reps after the pronated sets. Use your Week 3 working weights as a starting point and increase where you can.
"}]
